title: Fermi GBM GRB250206A spectra and responses
publisher: NASA Fermi Gamma-ray Burst Monitor / HEASARC
deterministic_selection_rule: All 105 glg_* files except glg_tte_* from the frozen official trigger directory; all 14 detectors and supplied responses retained.

measurement_dates.description: GRB250206A / bn250206827 on 2025-02-06; FITS HDUs retain exact DATE-OBS/DATE-END and time-reference fields.
measurement_dates.status: documented where explicit; otherwise unknown, never inferred from release

author_preprocessing: NASA calibrated/binned count and response products, not raw spacecraft packets. TTE events are intentionally omitted. Detector response and temporal binning constrain resolvable timescales.
known_analyses_and_limitations: This is one burst already reported in GCN circular 39290; detectors are complementary views, not independent bursts. Exact identities relating hardness definitions are not discoveries. Response folding is required for physical spectral interpretation.
